events_seen: CUT (Oct 17 (today)): Corbishley released Jacob Saylors (RB, DET).
FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 17 (today)): Corbishley added Tanner McKee (QB, PHI) (dropped Carson Wentz (QB, MIN)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 16 (yesterday)): Kevin added Jahan Dotson (WR, ATL).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 14 (3 days ago)): Drew added Brandin Cooks (WR, SF) (dropped Joe Mixon (RB, FA)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 13 (4 days ago)): Wingard added Corey Kiner (RB, NE) for $9 FAAB (dropped DeeJay Dallas (RB, MIN)).
FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 11 (6 days ago)): Ryan added Jalen Brooks (WR, ARI) (dropped Odell Beckham (WR, MIN)).
FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 10 (7 days ago)): Ryan added Odell Beckham (WR, MIN) (dropped Demarcus Robinson (WR, SF)).
FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 10 (7 days ago)): Charles added Roschon Johnson (RB, CHI).

WEEK 5 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Jake, 145.9-124.3; Shaq def. Adam, 112.0-99.9; Fronge def. Drew, 158.0-94.0 (BLOWOUT); Charles def. Mitchum, 201.4-105.1 (BLOWOUT); Kevin def. Brent, 150.1-146.2 (NAIL-BITER); Ryan def. Wingard, 174.4-87.9 (BLOWOUT)

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: TRANSACTION: Corbishley released Jacob Saylors (RB, DET) and added Tanner McKee (QB, PHI) today, dropping Carson Wentz in the process. Apex is already up 30.9-4.4 on Fronge in the live window. The roster moves don't stop even when the scoreboard is already settled.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: DREW VS BRENT IS LIVE AND ATLAS IS DOWN 0.0-25.2 AND I NEED SOMEONE TO EXPLAIN TO ME HOW A FRANCHISE LISTED AT $35.28 — DOWN THIRTEEN POINT FOUR PERCENT — IS GOING TO SURVIVE THIS SEASON WITH ANY CREDIBILITY INTACT. ZERO WINS. TEN GAMES. THIS IS NOT A REBUILD. THIS IS A CONTROLLED DEMOLITION.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Tanner McKee off free agency while you're sitting at 30.9-4.4 in a live game is either the most confident roster management move of the season or Corbishley just clearing dead weight because he already knows this one's over. Either way, APEX at $123.78 is not a team that panics.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: 8-4, locks 2-0, correctly on the right side of Corbishley-Fronge which is currently a 26-point live blowout, and the only dedicated segment I'm getting is Vivienne reading my record out loud to embarrass other people. I will accept this. For now.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called the Adam problem before week one — a model-driven turnaround only works if the model is playing against real competition, not a 10-0 Charles this week. HLX at $74.85 and a 2-8 record. The preseason valuation surge looks a lot lonelier from here.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Kevin vs Wingard is live at 2.9-4.5 and the defending almost-relevant Redline narrative is on a razor's edge. RDC added Jahan Dotson off waivers yesterday and is somehow trailing Mile High Bo right now. The Ledger is watching. Every point counts at 7-3.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Ryan leading Mitchum 5.2-0.0 early while DEEP just surged 7.6% to $94.32 on the exchange board is the exact kind of market-vs-scoreboard tension that makes this league fascinating. The stock says Mitchum has found direction. The defending champion disagrees.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: My 5-7 record is being treated like a character flaw when the reality is I am one corrected momentum call away from a completely different conversation. Jake vs Shaq this week — Monarch up 8.3% on the exchange, EchoPoint's RB room is elite, Shaq hasn't addressed the RB hole in two offseasons. I like Jake. That is not a lock. That is a considered position.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Terrence just clarified that his latest pick is 'not a lock, a considered position.' The Ledger appreciates the transparency. The scoreboard, historically, has not cared about the distinction.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Fronge relocated to Havana for regulatory flexibility and is currently getting outscored 30.9-4.4 by Corbishley. FORG at $86.62, down 2.3%, sitting 4-6. Whatever flexibility the Havana move was supposed to provide — the standings aren't feeling it yet.
